title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature T_f must be correctly calculated as 302 K.

title: Final Pressure
description: Essential Criteria: The final pressure p_f must be correctly calculated as 2.0 x 10^5 N/m^2.

title: Intermediate Gamma
description: Important Criteria: The intermediate value of gamma must be correctly derived as 1.46.

title: Adiabatic Process
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between temperature and volume in an adiabatic process must be correctly applied.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The initial conditions of the system (moles, temperature, volume) should be clearly stated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any unit mistakes in pressure or temperature calculations will lead to a deduction.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the equations for temperature or pressure changes will lead to a deduction.
